args.message: Each region's top customer by revenue: East is customer 93 (3734.67), North is customer 130 (3868.47), South is customer 57 (3873.29) and West is customer 53 (3417.67). Revenue is the sum of every order amount for the customer, with both "ok" and "bad" statuses counted. One customer has no region and was left out. No region had a tie for first place.
